messages:
harper: Quick drop  a tiny 'review speed kit' for people who own hiring, policy, or benefits work. One-line IC answers + manager micro-lines so calibration packets are faster.

noah: Love it. Can you include a headcount/hiring KR example for managers to link work to hires?
zoe: Also add a short policy impact line for folks who shipped compliance docs (SOC2/GDPR).
harper: Added both. kept everything to 1-2 lines so its paste-ready. Draft below.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: review form templates close in 4 days. To include, file a ticket with this thread_ts.

harper: --- IC PASTE LINES (one-liners) ---
- Role elevator: "I lead [area] by [action] to improve [customer/org outcome]."
- Outcome metric: "Cut p95 latency from 560ms to 220ms; reduced error rate from 1.8% to 0.3%."
- Hiring KR (1 line): "Mentored 2 hires; reduced time-to-impact from 6w -> 3w enabling one extra shard this quarter."
- Policy/benefits KR (1 line): "Authored GDPR mapping and automated consent flow, cutting manual reviews by 65%."
- Quick improvement note: "Would start perf experiments earlier to avoid late rollbacks."

harper: --- MANAGER MICRO-LINES (pasteable) ---
- Evidence + effect: "Delivered measurable reliability gains; canary and dashboard confirm p95 drop and stable errors."
- Next action: "Assign owner for runbook adoption and set a 3-week checkpoint to validate."

harper: --- HIRING-OPS TEMPLATE (for managers, 1 line) ---
- "Hiring impact: mentorship + ramp metrics show new hires onboarded to production in half the expected time; continue to allocate pairing slots."

harper: --- BENEFITS/POLICY TEMPLATE (for managers, 1 line) ---
- "Policy outcome: automated flows and docs reduced manual handling and lowered risk for compliance audits."

harper: --- PEER DM (1-line examples) ---
- Quick ask: "Hey @NAME  2 quick lines on my handoff & clarity during the rollout? Thanks!"
- Hiring ask: "Hey @NAME  could you note how my mentorship went for the new hire I paired with? 1-2 lines ideal."

harper: --- CALIBRATION CHEAT-SHEET (for managers, 5 one-liners) ---
- Anchor claims to a concrete artifact (dashboard, perf test, canary).
- Prefer time-bounded metrics (before/after windows).
- Separate individual ownership from team outcomes.
- Verify hiring claims by mentee outputs (did they ship?).
- If policy work, confirm automation + docs exist, not only an email thread.

noah: This is perfect  short and scannable. I'll add to the calibration packet.
zoe: Helpful for policy folks especially. Thanks harper! :sparkles:
root_message: harper: Quick drop  a tiny 'review speed kit' for people who own hiring, policy, or benefits work. One-line IC answers + manager micro-lines so calibration packets are faster.
